blurb: 233 Starr Karaoke & Eats offers 13 private karaoke rooms and a spacious open bar area. Guests can sing from a library of over 250,000 songs updated monthly. The venue features a professional sound system and hosts various events including birthday, wedding, corporate, and kids' parties.
